title: Human Female Reproductive System Cell Atlas v1
description: Draft CAS(+) export. Labelsets = master L1-L4 nomenclature (cell_ontology_mapping.xlsx). Source-dataset labels in transferred_annotations; object's own labels + descriptors in author_annotations. Local extensions: per-annotation 'comment' (free-text provenance, agent-readable), and generic leaves minted for un-subtyped celltype_HCA_fine codes that share a nomenclature node with finer subtypes.

source.title: An integrated multimodal pan-organ atlas of the female reproductive system across the lifespan contextualises gynaecological pathologies

annotations.comment: Minted generic leaf for celltype_HCA_fine='Endo_ven_pcv' (13904 cells).
